title: fb-diag host state
description: Optional message of the Session owner to its viewers on the negotiated fb-diag DataChannel (id 0), ADR 0026 D3. State only: the owner's game is paused or running. Not a server message and not part of the WSS protocol; readers ignore unknown message types and unknown fields, so no protocol_version bump is needed.

paused.description: true while the owner's game is paused.

by.description: Display name of the user who paused (only with paused = true). Optional: a viewer without it names the Session owner.
